settings.sub_heading_text: Sunsetting Our Rewards Program On July 1, 2026, we ended MoMA Design Store Rewards. Customers can no longer earn Rewards points on eligible purchases. Existing balances of 150+ eligible points may still be redeemed online and in stores through June 30, 2027. You can continue to view your Rewards balance and redemption options in your account throughout the redemption period. We will send advance notices and reminder communications over the next year to ensure you have ample time to use your available Rewards. Rewards Members have until June 30, 2027 to redeem any remaining Rewards coupons. We’ll also launch hundreds of new designs over the coming months, giving you even more opportunities to redeem your balance. Please let us know if you need assistance checking your balance or redeeming Rewards points — we’re happy to help!

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.faq_1_question: What is happening to the MoMA Design Store Rewards program?
settings.faq_1_answer: As of July 1, 2026, we are sunsetting our Rewards program. You will no longer accumulate points on purchases or promotional activities. However, you have a 12-month window until June 30, 2027, to redeem any outstanding points balance of 150 points or more on hundreds of exciting new designs online and in-store.
settings.faq_2_question: How do I redeem my points?
settings.faq_2_answer: If you have an outstanding balance of 150 points or more, you have until June 30, 2027, to redeem them online or in-store before they expire (please note that individual point balances may also have an earlier expiration date based on your account activity). Every 150 points can be redeemed for $5 off, up to a maximum of $50 off per order. To redeem online, log into your account and select your eligible redemption amount at checkout. To redeem in-store, log into your account on your mobile device to generate your reward coupon code and present it to an associate at checkout.
settings.faq_3_question: Are my MoMA member benefits combinable with Rewards?
settings.faq_3_answer: No, Rewards points cannot be combined with your 10% daily member discount or Member Shopping Days promotions. However, MoMA members will still receive free standard shipping on online orders of $50 or more when redeeming their remaining points balance.
